q: Why limit how many password hashes run at once (a semaphore)?
o: Hashing is memory-hard: too many at once can exhaust the server
why: Argon2id uses lots of memory per hash.

q: The kid in a JWT header is used to …
o: pick the right key from the JWKS
why: Key id, so keys can rotate.

q: Under GDPR, a personal-data breach must usually be reported to the authority within …

o: a checklist standard for verifying application security
